name: Mannoroc Coven
summary: Burning Blade cultists keep portals open at Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace. They draw felhounds, succubi, and infernals into an ancient ruin, making it the Burning Legion’s largest stronghold in central Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Bastion of Fel Fire
sections.body: Mannoroc Coven lies south of Ghost Walker Post and east of Shadowprey Village. Fel-tainted ruins cover an ancient night elf settlement. Lord Azrethoc commands the demons, while Jugkar Grim'rod leads the Burning Blade warlocks. Their portals draw doomguards, infernals, and felhounds into Kalimdor. Horde-aligned travelers use relics such as the Hand of Iruxos to sever the links, but new rifts keep opening in the scarred earth.

faq.q: Why is this place called Mannoroc Coven?
faq.answer: The encampment takes its name from Mannoroth the Destructor. The pit lord subjugated the orcs with the blood curse and perished in Ashenvale.
Lord Azrethoc leads the demons, while Jugkar Grim'rod directs the mortal cultists as a warlock of the Burning Blade.

faq.q: What ruins was the coven built upon?
faq.answer: The encampment occupies the crumbling stone foundations of an ancient night elf settlement. Those ruins stood long before demons filled the region with fel magic.

faq.q: How are the demons arriving in Desolace?
faq.answer: Burning Blade cultists maintain summoning portals throughout the ruins. The portals draw continuous reinforcements from the Twisting Nether, frustrating outside attempts to cleanse the site for good.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can study the coven’s concentrated fel energy and active Legion portals. Demons appear before your eyes.
As a night elf, you see your ancestors’ stonework desecrated and trampled by demons. It recalls the War of the Ancients.
